name: A battle
what: Battles fought by the men in them: each man closes, fights, reels, falls or breaks; knights charge, ride through and come round again.

versions.label: Men fight on their own, two attack clips
versions.what: First cut on the new battle mind: the fight works, but every man repeats the same two attacks (the jumping slash). Your note.

versions.label: Every fight move, with answers
versions.what: Each man varies his cuts (five slashes, two thrusts, a kick); the other parries, dodges or reels on the same frame; men fall the way the blow drives them; the beaten break sooner and some wounded yield. Part of the run; the full film follows.

versions.label: Dead stay down, sides in colour
versions.what: Every man now moves through Godot's animation state machine, whose Dead state nothing leaves: the fallen stay down. Each army wears its house's colour (green against tan), knights ride through and come round, the beaten break and their standard falls, the victors cheer.

versions.label: Every man in the fight, legs on the ground
versions.what: The ranks behind push in on their own count instead of standing for the whole fight; legs follow how fast each man really moves (no running on the spot, no gliding); the crowd moves through Godot's avoidance so nobody walks through anyone; the camera stays on the fight.

name: A siege
what: Kingsmere under siege: engines, the besiegers' camp, assault parties going to the wall and back.

versions.label: Assault parties on LimboAI
versions.what: Each attacker has his own state machine: waits in camp, goes forward behind his shield, runs the last stretch, fights at the foot of the wall with varied cuts and guards, falls back, or is cut down and stays down while the camp sends a fresh man.

versions.label: The camera goes in on each rush
versions.what: When a party is sent at the wall, the camera comes in low from the camp side on that stretch, so the fight at the foot of the wall reads.

name: A castle's courtyard
what: Kingsmere's bailey: the yard inside the castle walls.

versions.label: Furnished, seen from above
versions.what: Barn, carts, hay, a fire pit and a log pile in the yard, but nobody there, the house blocking the gate, and the camera only able to look down from over the walls.

versions.label: Lived in, and the camera can come into the yard
versions.what: The garrison drills under a sergeant, a groom warms at the fire, a servant carries; the house moved off the gate; the yard is open air to the camera, so it comes down inside.

versions.label: The drill out in the open
versions.what: The garrison drills in the open half of the yard, clear of the keep's shadow, each at his own move, the sergeant facing them from the gate side.

name: A town at mid zoom
what: Goldrock seen at a mid zoom: its square, streets and houses.

versions.label: The square packed
versions.what: About 35 people bunched in the middle of the square.

versions.label: Busy, never a press
versions.what: The square holds at most 14 bound for it at once; anyone else keeps to their own door. People read one by one.

name: A town up close
what: Goldrock's square with the camera close in.

versions.label: Looking down from above
versions.what: Clearing the roofs, the camera climbed until it looked about 55 degrees down: roofs, not the town.

versions.label: Low and oblique
versions.what: Past 42 degrees the camera steps back along its line instead of climbing: walls, stalls and people read.

name: A feast
what: A town feasting round a fire in its square.

versions.label: Smoke over everyone
versions.what: The fire's smoke sat over the dancers as a dense white ball.

versions.label: A thin drifting haze
versions.what: Thin, see-through smoke that drifts off on the air; the ring round the fire reads, most dancing and some clapping, laughing and waving them on.

name: A town changes hands
what: The old lord's banner falls, the new lord's men march in, his banner rises.

versions.label: Hidden behind the church
versions.what: The camera looked across the town's tall church; the scene in the square was a blur behind it.

versions.label: From a clear side
versions.what: Before framing any scene the camera picks a side with no tall building in the way (and fells trees on that side). The new lord's men march in, his banner rises, they salute and cheer.
